notes: Each provider phase is one per-run authority: envelope digest + the preview digest shown by the preceding local phase.

A projection projects the latest transition, so the first projection follows the intake transition (revision 2); at revision 1 the product returns projection_transition_unavailable (internal/workflow/service.go prepareProjection).
Execution revisions are deterministic (start = 1; every advance or fact +1, as in cmd/lingo/s9_dogfood_blackbox_test.go); a mismatch is denied by Axiom with no effect.
specSHA256/planSHA256 come from D1 (dogfood base); graphEvidenceSHA256 is the SHA-256 of D4's acceptance-evidence.json.
